newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to offer $1.0 bln global bond - Salomon Bros.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to offer $1.0 bln global bond - Salomon Bros.

text.p: Mexico's federal government will offer a $1.0 billion dollar-denominated global bond issue at a fixed rate, Salomon Brothers said in a statement.
The company said that the Mexican Ministry of Finance and Public Credit expects the bonds to have a ten-year maturity.
"The interest rate and price of the bonds are expected to be determined by the end of next week, with delivery of the bonds occurring one week later," Salomon Brothers said.
Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers are joint lead managers of the proposed global issue.
